title: Browse compact object animation families
changes: Add eight caller-witnessed compact OBJ animation catalogs to the scoped object viewer, preserving sparse list IDs, sequence selectors, source offsets and resource links.
Reuse frame playback, optional looping, manual graphics and palettes while retaining controls across compact and existing catalogs.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-compact-synthetic-sbzmnfjp passed 35 projection, browser and existing-view checks, including sparse IDs and manually paired pixels.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-compact-recovered-tca_p6t8 matched eight JSON hashes and 22 source ranges, then checked 171 lists, 33 sequences and 338 frames in Chrome.
The same unit matched all 12 Docker/Python files; three validated ignored wiki pages were published with guarded preimages.
limitations: The viewer covers extracted caller-witnessed projections only. Graphics/palette pairing and timing are illustrative; affine, mosaic and special effects are not reconstructed. Native Windows, other previews and exact audio remain open.
